title: yummy golden ukrainian chicken bite
description: flaky roasted chicken bites made with double-fried kfc and chilled butter, perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: kfc-style double-fried chicken
ingredients.notes: available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together gluten-free flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken breasts to the bowl and toss to coat with the flour mixture.
Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coated chicken breasts to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried chicken to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the chicken in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, prepare the double-fried KFC-style chicken according to package instructions.
Once the chicken is done, let it cool for a few minutes before shredding it into bite-sized pieces.
In a small saucepan, melt the chilled butter over low heat.
Add the shredded chicken to the saucepan and toss with the melted butter until well coated.
Serve the chicken bites hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
